decisive_items: a solid, well-demarcated, hyperechoic, hypoperfused 1.3 × 1.1 cm mass at the tail of the right epididymis
a painless, round, hazelnut-sized mass localized to the tail of the right epididymis
response.rationale: The solid, well-demarcated, hyperechoic nature on ultrasound is characteristic of adenomatoid tumor, the most common epididymal tumor. Cystic lesions (epididymal cyst, spermatocele) are excluded by the solid appearance, and sperm granuloma is unlikely without trauma or inflammation.

rejected.why: Epididymal cyst is cystic, but ultrasound shows a solid mass.
Spermatocele is cystic and would appear anechoic, not solid and hyperechoic.
Sperm granuloma typically follows trauma or inflammation and is not hyperechoic; no such history.
